description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded header-only cache
prompts: cache.h's Cache is an unbounded std::unordered_map wrapper - get/put never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: the constructor Cache(int capacity, long long ttl) takes a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. put(const std::string& key, int value, long long now) stores a value timestamped at `now`. get returns a bool and writes the value out through an int* out-parameter: `bool get(const std::string& key, long long now, int* out)` returns true and sets *out if the key is present AND not expired (now - storedAt < ttl), else returns false (and *out is untouched) - an expired entry observed by get must be REMOVED immediately. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put would exceed capacity with a genuinely new key, evict the LEAST recently used entry first.
name: add_cpp_lru_cache_with_ttl
